# Main Street IQ

> Main Street IQ is a fractional CFO practice for owner-operated businesses under $50MM in revenue, with a built-in intelligence engine. Led by Scott Hess, it pairs a named fractional or interim CFO with an engine that reads your market, your funnel, your cohorts, and what AI search says about you; the CFO works those decisions alongside you, not from the sideline. The practice concentrates on California's Central Coast and Southern California and serves fitting owner-operated businesses nationwide, with the deepest work in e-commerce, wine, health and wellness, and elective medicine. Every engagement is built on the proprietary RAID Framework (Redundant, Agile, Intelligent, Data-Driven).

## Start Here

Main Street IQ runs two connected lines of work. Buyers usually arrive looking for one of them.

- [Main Street IQ, Homepage](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/): A fractional CFO practice with a built-in intelligence engine. Reads your market, funnel, cohorts, and AI-search visibility, then works those decisions alongside you. For owner-operated ecommerce brands, wineries, wellness practices, and elective medicine practices under $50MM. Rooted on the California coast, working with owner-operators nationwide. Veteran-owned and operated.
- [Fractional CFO, the CFO lane hub](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/fractional-cfo): Senior finance leadership for owner-operated businesses under $50MM, built on the RAID model with a live intelligence engine underneath, delivered by a named CFO rather than software. Engage when you keep your finance team; Manage when you want Main Street IQ to be it. Start here for anything about CFO, controller, or finance-leadership work.
- [AI Discoverability, the visibility lane hub](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/discoverability): Finds every place a prospect can discover a business across classical search, answer engines, and AI chat, then optimizes and manages that footprint. Proven first in wine, built to run across ecommerce, wellness, and elective medicine. Start here for anything about AI search visibility, AEO, GEO, or being recommended by AI assistants.
- [Book an Intro Call](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/intro-call): Thirty minutes, founder-to-founder, no pitch and no obligation.

## Core Services

- [Fractional CFO, Ongoing](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/our-services): 10–15 hours/week embedded finance leadership (fractional or interim CFO) covering month-end close, cash/margin visibility, investor reporting, and cross-functional strategy.
- [Advisory, Light Touch](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/our-services): ~10 hours/month strategic oversight for companies with existing finance teams.
- [Project-Based](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/our-services): Discrete engagements: financial modeling, M&A preparation, close process redesign, investor reporting packages.
- [Manage](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/manage): The productized embedded finance and accounting function for owner-operated companies under $50M. One fractional CFO, one named operator, four workstreams, and a CEO dashboard. Daily bookkeeping held to a 99%+ accuracy standard, 13-week cash forecasting, cohort unit economics, monthly close signed in eight days. Scoped on an Intro Call.
- [Interim Finance Leadership](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/interim-finance-leadership): For when a CFO, Finance Director, or Head of Finance has just left or is about to. Embeds quickly, stabilizes the function, and sets up the next permanent hire.
- [Finance Director Services](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/finance-director-services): FP&A, management reporting, and operational finance leadership for companies that need the function but not the CFO price tag.
- [The RAID Framework](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/raid-framework): How Main Street IQ builds and runs a finance function: Redundant, Agile, Intelligent, Data-Driven. The operating standard behind every Engage and Manage engagement.

A diagnosis, not a dashboard to interpret. Built for owner-operated wineries, wellness clinics, elective medicine practices, and ecommerce brands.

Scored 0 to 100 from public data, sent within one business day. Open to any California winery or tasting room.

The original primary research behind the discoverability practice.

## Glossary

- [Finance & AI Glossary](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary): Plain-language definitions of the finance and AI-search terms behind an AI CFO.
- [AI Visibility](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/ai-visibility): AI visibility is how often, and how accurately, AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity name your business when someone asks them a question you should be the answer to.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/answer-engine-optimization): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of structuring your content so that answer engines, the AI systems and featured-snippet tools that give a single direct answer, pull from your business as the source.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/generative-engine-optimization): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is optimizing your business's presence so that generative AI models, the large language models behind ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, represent and recommend you accurately when they generate a response.
- [LLM Citation](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/llm-citation): An LLM citation is when a large language model names or links to your business as a source or recommendation inside the answer it generates for a user.
- [llms.txt](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/llms-txt): llms.txt is a plain-text file placed at the root of a website that gives AI systems a clean, curated summary of what the site is about and which pages matter most, the way robots.txt speaks to search crawlers.
- [Schema Markup (Structured Data)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/schema-markup): Schema markup is standardized code you add to your web pages that labels your content, this is a business name, this is a price, this is an FAQ, so search engines and AI systems can read it unambiguously.
- [Entity & Knowledge Graph](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/entity-knowledge-graph): An entity is a distinct thing a search or AI system recognizes, a specific business, person, or place, and a knowledge graph is the connected map of facts these systems hold about that entity and how it relates to others.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation): Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique where an AI model, before answering, retrieves relevant up-to-date information from an external source and uses it to ground its response, rather than relying only on what it memorized during training.
- [AI CFO](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/ai-cfo): An AI CFO is a fractional Chief Financial Officer whose work is powered by a built-in intelligence engine: an operator who turns your financial data into decisions, delivered by a person, not a software product you log into.
- [Fractional CFO](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/fractional-cfo): A fractional CFO is an experienced Chief Financial Officer who works with a company part-time, providing senior strategic finance leadership without the cost of a full-time executive hire.
- [Contribution Margin](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/contribution-margin): Contribution margin is the revenue left from a sale after subtracting the variable costs of delivering it, the money each sale contributes toward covering fixed costs and, beyond that, profit.
- [Unit Economics](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/unit-economics): Unit economics is the profitability of a single unit of your business, one product sold or one customer served, measured by the direct revenues and costs tied to that unit.
- [CAC:LTV Ratio](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cac-ltv-ratio): The CAC:LTV ratio compares what it costs to acquire a customer (customer acquisition cost) against how much profit that customer generates over their relationship with you (lifetime value), the core test of whether your growth is efficient.
- [Cash Conversion Cycle](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cash-conversion-cycle): The cash conversion cycle is the time it takes for a dollar you spend, on inventory or delivering a service, to come back to you as collected cash from a customer.
- [Cohort Analysis](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cohort-analysis): Cohort analysis groups customers by when they first bought, then tracks how each group behaves over time, so you can see whether customers are getting more or less valuable, and whether retention is improving or decaying.

## Verticals

The four verticals where the practice goes deepest. Each page reads the economics of that business model specifically, not a generic CFO pitch.

- [Ecommerce and DTC Brands](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/ecommerce): Fractional CFO and business advisory for owner-operated ecommerce and DTC brands, wherever they are headquartered. How a CFO reads the channel mix, one channel at a time.
- [Wineries and Tasting Rooms](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wineries): The wine practice. Customer acquisition intelligence and fractional CFO advisory for owner-operator wineries and tasting rooms on California's Central Coast.
- [Wellness Clinics](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wellness): Fractional CFO and business intelligence for owner-operated wellness clinics. Longevity, IV therapy, hormone optimization, functional medicine, recovery. Each modality has its own economics.
- [Elective Medicine Practices](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/aesthetics): Fractional CFO and business intelligence for owner-operated elective medicine practices. Cosmetic surgery, dermatology, MedSpa, cosmetic dental, adult cosmetic orthodontics. Each modality has its own economics.

## Assessments

Short, self-serve reads that return a scored profile and a recommended starting point.

- [Winery Assessment](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/winery-assessment): A 6-minute assessment for Central Coast wineries. Returns a personalized Winery Profile naming the growth outcomes worth going after first, and a recommended starting point. Free.
- [Wellness Practice Assessment](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wellness-assessment): A short assessment for multi-modality wellness practices. Surfaces where the practice is winning, where it is leaking, and where the next 12 months should go across service lines.
- [Elective Medicine Practice Assessment](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/aesthetics-assessment): A short assessment for elective medicine, cosmetic dental, and adult orthodontic practices. Surfaces where the practice is winning, where it is leaking, and where the next 12 months should go.
- [Ecommerce Brand Assessment](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/ecommerce-assessment): A short assessment for owner-operated ecommerce and DTC brands. Surfaces where the brand is winning, where margin is leaking, and where the next 12 months should go.
- [Financial Stack Quick Read](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/financial-stack): A five-minute, ten-question read of the financial operations underneath a business. Scores how resilient the banking, treasury, float, credit, and liquidity layers are, and shows where the gaps sit. Free, scored on the spot.

## The RAID Framework

Every engagement is structured around four principles:
- **Redundant**: Documented, cross-trained processes with no single points of failure.
- **Agile**: Automation-first: build systems before hiring people.
- **Intelligent**: Finance teams as owner-operators, not scorekeepers.
- **Data-Driven**: Every team member owns 3–5 KPIs tied to real business levers.

Close of the Found by the Machine series.

### The RAID Framework Series (8 parts)
- [Why Most Finance Teams Fail to Scale](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/why-finance-teams-fail-to-scale): The pattern of finance breaking at $20M, and the 4 failure modes. Series opener.
- [Automate First: Why Tools Come Before People](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/automate-first): The "Agile" principle: automation before headcount. AP, AR, expense, and reconciliation automation.
- [Build Redundant Finance: No More Single Points of Failure](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/build-redundant-finance): The "Redundant" principle: documentation, cross-training, and system access redundancy.
- [Stay Agile: Shrink the Team, Grow the Revenue](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/stay-agile): Organizational agility, why a $25M company needs 3 finance people, not 8.
- [Intelligent Teams Think Like Owners](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/intelligent-teams): The "Intelligent" principle: scorekeepers vs. owner-operators. Building teams that drive decisions.
- [Moneyball Metrics: The 3–5 KPIs Each Role Must Own](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/moneyball-metrics): The "Data-Driven" principle: stage-based KPI selection and ownership by role.
- [RAID Tech Stack: Tools That Reduce FTEs](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/raid-tech-stack): The specific tools: QBO vs NetSuite, Bill.com, Ramp, FloQast, Mosaic.
- [Investor-Ready Finance: Fewer FTE, More Control](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/investor-ready-finance): The 5 things investors look for in your finance function. Series conclusion.

### RAID in Action
- [RAID in Action](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/raid-in-action): Real-world case study of the RAID Framework applied to a growing company: the problems, the fixes, and the results.

### Annual Planning Series (6 parts)
- [Why an Annual Plan Matters](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/why-annual-plan-matters): The real value of annual planning isn't the document, it's forcing alignment between revenue, expenses, headcount, and cash flow.
- [Revenue Growth Planning](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/revenue-growth-planning): Building bottoms-up revenue models by channel with unit economics, capacity constraints, and scenario analysis.
- [Expense Controls](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/expense-controls): Separating fixed from variable, benchmarking against revenue percentages, and building approval workflows that catch bad spending early.
- [Marketing Spend Planning](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/marketing-spend-planning): Tying marketing spend to CAC targets by channel, setting payback period guardrails, and giving marketing a flexible budget framework.
- [Balance Sheet Management](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/balance-sheet-management): Managing working capital, inventory, and receivables proactively; the balance sheet tells you what the P&L can't.
- [Planning for Unknowns](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/planning-for-unknowns): Scenario planning, contingency reserves, and monthly reforecasting that turn a rigid plan into a flexible operating framework.

### Acquisition & Growth Series (6 parts)
- [SEO vs GEO vs AEO: What Each One Actually Does for Growth](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/seo-vs-geo-vs-aeo-explained): Three acronyms, three different optimization targets. SEO ranks you, GEO finds you, AEO quotes you. What each one unlocks for growth and which layer is most likely leaking today.
- [If Your Month-End Close Takes More Than 7 Days](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/month-end-close): How to go from an 18-day close to a 5-day close in 90 days.

- [Tariffs and Lower Middle Market COGS](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/tariffs-lower-middle-market-cogs): How tariffs cascade through pricing, margins, inventory strategy, and cash flow, plus how to model for them.
- [Your Comp Structure Is Driving the Wrong Behavior](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/comp-structure-wrong-behavior): When compensation plans don't align with margin, cash collection, and retention, you're paying people to optimize the wrong things.
- [The Payback Window Problem](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/payback-window-problem): Why most companies calculate payback period wrong, and how getting it right changes which channels you scale.
- [Your Marketing Team Is Optimizing for the Wrong Search Engine](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/marketing-team-wrong-search-engine): Traditional SEO is still the default line item in most marketing budgets, while AI search has quietly become a measurable discovery channel with different economics. What a CFO should be asking about it.

- [Running a Business With a Better CFO](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/running-business-better-cfo): What changes when you bring in senior finance leadership that understands the business, not just the books.
- [What Your CAC Number Doesn't Include](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/what-cac-number-doesnt-include): The hidden costs that inflate your real customer acquisition cost beyond what the marketing dashboard reports.

Real CFO work is different, and here's the test to tell them apart.
- [The CFO Filter: Five Questions Before You Adopt the Next AI Tool](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/cfo-filter-for-ai): Every week a new AI tool lands in the inbox and the vendor list grows. The five questions a CFO runs before any of them get adopted, and why most fail at least one.
